mode: Built-in image_gen; transparent_background=true; one distinct asset per call
sharedPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one premium small 3D category illustration for the GoRez booking website, not a website mockup.
Style: realistic high-end miniature product rendering, physically based materials, precise believable object shapes, refined soft studio lighting from upper left, gentle three-quarter orthographic view. Clear bold silhouette readable at 40px; subtle realistic texture, not flat line art, not a toy, not a generic emoji.
Palette: natural silver/chrome and graphite materials with restrained warm orange #ff762f accents, ivory highlights. Fits a warm white, graphite and orange premium SaaS interface.
Composition: square 1:1, one centered isolated icon composition occupying about 82% of the canvas, complete object with generous safe edge padding. No cropped parts.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, only a tiny soft natural shadow immediately under the object. No colored rectangle, no floor, no pedestal, no circular badge, no checkerboard painted in.
Constraints: no text, no numbers, no logos, no trademarks, no watermark, no people, no face, no sparkle glyphs, no decorative orb.
